title: International Scout Engines (1961–1980)
description: Every factory engine in the International Scout by year, 1961–1980: the Comanche fours, AMC sixes, IH V-266, V-304 and V-345 V8s, and the Nissan diesels.
intro: International Harvester built the Scout from 1961 to 1980: the Scout 80, the Scout 800 series and the Scout II, with the Terra and Traveler from 1976. IH quoted gross horsepower through 1972 and net from 1973.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.

generations.name: Scout 80
intro: The 152 Comanche four, half of IH's 304 V8.

generations.name: Scout 800, 800A and 800B
intro: The 152 and 196 fours, a turbocharged 152, the AMC 232 six, and the IH V-266 and V-304.

generations.name: Scout II
intro: The 196 four, the AMC 258 six for 1972, the V-304 and V-345, and the Nissan SD33 diesel from 1976 and SD33T turbodiesel for 1980.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
